name: Jambres
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Your pastor is just like Jannes and Jambres that resisted Moses; they always resisted the truth. We come out and teach you the truth: you're the Israelites, you went into slavery because you broke the commandments of the Most High God, but Christ died for you and he's coming to return and deliver you from the United States of America, Babylon the great. And your pastor goes, oh no, that's not it.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
